term: divine presence mediated through narratives or liturgy
definition: Rea proposes that narratives and liturgies can mediate divine presence, sometimes without extraordinary sensory experience. This is a possible Christian account of communion, not proof that every nonresister already has explicit access or that the underlying historical reports are true.
